title: Gallery with page morph
notes: Morphing a thumbnail into a full page used to require a single-page app: a router, a history listener and a script to measure and animate both images. Cross-document view transitions do it across two ordinary page loads.

Both pages opt in with `@view-transition`, and each thumbnail shares its `view-transition-name` with the image on its own page. Browsers without support simply load the page, and reduced motion turns the opt-in off.
